title: Coord: Joint SI + Marketplace ecosystem sprint workshop
text:
Coord: Joint SI + Marketplace ecosystem sprint workshop

["From: Elaine Tsai <elaine@cloudmosaic.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Timmons <jtimmons@cloudmosaic.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed dates for joint ecosystem sprint workshop

Hi Sean / Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here is excited about the marketplace packaging angle. We'd like to schedule a 3-hour deep-dive with our integration engineers and the marketplace product owner to align on delivery scope and technical handoffs.

Our initial availability:
- Tue Jun 23, 9:00am–12:00 PDT
- Wed Jun 24, 11:00am–2:00pm PDT
- Thu Jun 25, 8:00am–11:00am PDT

Agenda we imagine: short intros, integration touchpoints (auth, billing, routing), network/hosting constraints, and a working run of the connector. I attached a draft agenda.

Can you confirm who from Redwood should attend and whether any of those windows work?

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Tsai
Head of Partnerships | CloudMosaic Solutions

Attachments: redwood-cloudmosaic-workshop-agenda-v1.pdf (application/pdf)", "From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Tsai <elaine@cloudmosaic.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, James Timmons <jtimmons@cloudmosaic.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed dates for joint ecosystem sprint workshop

Hi Elaine — thanks for laying this out. Camila (solutions engineering) and I will take point. Marissa from our marketplace team should be on the session for packaging and listing questions.

We can do Wed Jun 24, 11:00am–2:00pm PDT — that works best for all three of us. If that holds, we'll reserve a calendar block and outline a tighter agenda (including timeboxes for the run).

Two quick asks before the meeting:
- Can you share a short network/hosting constraints doc or link (eg VPC peering, proxy requirements)?
- Who specifically will run the connector test (name + role)?

I'll send a calendar invite after you confirm.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192", "From: James Timmons <jtimmons@cloudmosaic.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Tsai <elaine@cloudmosaic.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed dates for joint ecosystem sprint workshop

Sean — Wed Jun 24 works for us but a heads up: our lead integration engineer (Ravi Patel) is out Thursday and Friday; he prefers Tue or Wed. Ravi will be the one to run the connector test.

We'll attach a short note on our network requirements by EOD tomorrow.

James
Director, Solutions Engineering | CloudMosaic

Thanks James — appreciate the heads up about Ravi. Wed Jun 24 still works for us. We'll prepare a short checklist for the run (auth, endpoint mapping, sample request/response, logs).

Marissa, can you review the draft agenda and add a 20-min slot for marketplace packaging questions?

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed dates for joint ecosystem sprint workshop

Hi all — small change: Ravi just flagged a customer incident that may keep him in a war room on Wed morning; he expects to be available by 1pm PT but not by 11am. Would you be able to shift the session by two hours to 1:00pm–4:00pm PDT on Wed Jun 24 so Ravi can join the full run?

If we shift, we also want a 30-minute pre-call at 12:15pm for quick environment checks (credential smoke test, dependencies). Attached is our network constraints note and a small network diagram.

Elaine

Attachments: cloudmosaic-network-constraints.pdf (application/pdf), network-diagram-stub.png (image/png)

Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed dates for joint ecosystem sprint workshop

Great — thanks for the update, Elaine. We can shift to 1:00pm–4:00pm PDT on Wed Jun 24.

We'll do the 12:15pm pre-call for environment checks. Quick logistics:
- I'll create a shared folder with sample manifests and packaging checklist.
- Sean, can you send the calendar invite with conferencing details + the 12:15 pre-call stub?
- Camila, please prepare the run checklist and sample POST payloads.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Marketplace | Redwood Inference
